tempo.basis: from five complete recordings, median 3:21 (Connolly/Martineau 3:21, Hyperion CDA67336 3:11, Guilmette/Godin 3:01, Munger/Baril 3:37, Graham/Martineau 3:21), 1.5 s allowed for silence; Fauré marks it Adagio molto tranquillo

notes: A wordless vocalise (1906), written as a sight-singing and examination piece for the Paris Conservatoire. There are no words, so there are no phrases, translation or IPA; sing it on a vowel of your choice.
